t: Thin, bio-based oil spray lubricant with rust and corrosion inhibitors. Cleans rust, grease, dirt and residue, maintains materials and mechanisms. Can be used to release rusted screws, nuts and bolts, displace moisture, remove squeak and creak noises, as well as lubricate and help to restore movement. Also helps to restore electrical contact. Ideal for use around the home, car and garden, as well as metalworking shops, automotive, mechanical engineering, and in the hobby sector.
